::: {.csf-hero}
<p class="csf-hero__eyebrow"><i class="bi bi-stars"></i> For first timers</p>

<h1 class="csf-hero__title">Turn up. Make it <em>together</em>.</h1>

<p class="csf-hero__lede">
One thing is worth saying twice, because everybody assumes the opposite:
<strong>you don't cook anything beforehand and you don't bring a dish.</strong>
You arrive with empty hands, and the whole group makes one dessert together, on the spot.
</p>
:::

::: {.csf-section}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">an evening with us</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">The four steps</h2>

::: {.csf-steps}
- ### Send us a message
  One message on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/cuochi_senza_fuochi/),
  [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@cuochi_senza_fuochi) or
  [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@cuochisenzafuochi). We reply with the place, the
  time and the dessert of the evening.

- ### Come empty-handed
  Ingredients, bowls, a fridge: it's all there. Whoever is hosting does the shopping,
  so all you have to do is find the door.

- ### Make it together
  Someone walks the group through a recipe that needs no oven and no stove. Crushing,
  mixing and layering get shared out. It takes about an hour.

- ### Eat it, keep the people
  Into the fridge, then onto the plates. You leave with a recipe you can redo without a
  kitchen, and with the numbers of the people you made it with.
:::
:::

::: {.csf-quote}
Come for the cake. **Stay for the people.**
:::

::: {.csf-section}
<p class="csf-section__kicker">good questions</p>
<h2 class="csf-section__title">The things everybody asks</h2>
<p class="csf-section__sub">If yours isn't here, just ask it in a message. We answer.</p>

::: {.csf-faq}
::: {.csf-faq__hot}
### So I really don't bring anything?
Really. This isn't a potluck. Whoever hosts does the shopping, and the recipes are cheap
enough that nobody collects money at the door. Turn up with your hands free.
:::

::: {.csf-faq__hot}
### Is it a competition?
Not at all. Nobody is graded, nobody wins, and a wobbly cheesecake gets eaten just as
fast as a perfect one. We make one dessert together, as a team.
:::

::: {}
### How do I sign up?
Send one message to any of our accounts; they all reach the same people.
[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/cuochi_senza_fuochi/) and
[TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@cuochi_senza_fuochi) are **&#64;cuochi_senza_fuochi**,
[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@cuochisenzafuochi) is **&#64;cuochisenzafuochi**.
No form, nothing to pay.
:::

::: {}
### I genuinely can't cook. Is that a problem?
It's closer to a qualification. Every recipe is chosen so that someone who has never
made anything can get it right, first try, in a group.
:::

::: {}
### What does it cost?
Nothing to join. No membership, no fee, no collection at the door.
:::

::: {}
### What do we make?
Mostly desserts and cakes, because they're the easiest things to make well without heat:
salame di cioccolato, tiramisù, no-bake cheesecake, chocolate mousse.
[All the recipes](recipes.qmd).
:::

::: {}
### Do I need to bring a friend?
Most people come alone. That's the normal way to arrive, and nobody finds it odd: the
whole point is that you don't know anyone yet.
:::

::: {}
### What language is spoken?
Italian and English, often in the same sentence. If your Italian stops at *"un caffè, per
favore"*, you'll still have a great evening.
:::

::: {}
### I have allergies, or I'm vegetarian or vegan
Tell us when you sign up. It changes what gets bought, so it really helps to know in
advance. There's almost always a version that works.
:::

::: {}
### How many people come, and how often?
Usually ten to twenty: enough to meet new people, few enough to actually talk. Roughly
once a month, in the evening, in a shared flat or common room in Padova.
:::

::: {}
### I don't live in Padova
Then maybe your city is next. [Here's how to start one](cities.qmd), and we'll help.
:::

::: {}
### Is this a networking thing?
No. People do end up helping each other with flats, jobs and doctors, but the way
neighbours do: as a side effect, not the agenda.
:::
:::
:::
